newsitem.title: UK: UK motor spirit deliveries rose slightly in Q4 '96.
newsitem.headline: UK motor spirit deliveries rose slightly in Q4 '96.

text.p: British motor spirit deliveries increased slightly in the fourth quarter of 1996 against the same period in 1995, the Department of Trade and Industry said on Thursday
The DTI said total motor spirit deliveries rose by 0.8 percent, while motor diesel (derv fuel) deliveries increased by 4.4 percent.
Fuel oil deliveries fell by 0.2 percent.
Deliveries of unleaded petrol in the fourth quarter of 1996 represented 68.9 percent of total motor spirit deliveries compared with 64.5.

On the price front, the DTI said 4-star petrol, super unleaded and premium unleaded increased by 2.1, 2.2 and 2.0 pence per litre respectively, mainly as a result of a three pence per litre rise in Britain's petrol tax which took effect at the end of November.
They said the rise did not appear to have been passed on the consumer as yet.

The three-month average price for the fourth quarter was 8.6 percent higher for 4-star petrol, 16.1 percent higher for super unleaded petrol and 11.7 percent higher for premium unleaded petrol than in the corresponding period of 1995, the DTI said.
